programs.title: The 90-Day Total Core Program
programs.subtitle: From your first deep squeeze to real, solid strength in 13 weeks.

weeks.themeSubtitle: The original week: switch on the deep muscles that hold you steady.

days.title: Activate Deep Core
days.intention: Today I build core strength by waking the deep muscles that work like a corset.

days.title: Rotational Power
days.intention: Today I build core strength by learning to twist with power and control.

days.title: The Stability Test
days.intention: Today I build core strength by keeping a rock-solid middle even when I am off balance.

days.title: Full Body Integration
days.intention: Today I build core strength by using my abs in every move I make.

days.title: The Endurance Burn
days.intention: Today I build core strength by holding my muscles tight for longer.

days.intention: Today I build core strength by reacting fast and strong to every move.

days.title: Ultimate Stability
days.intention: Today I build core strength by trusting my body to handle whatever comes.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Feel exactly which muscles switch on. Precision before power.

days.title: Foundation Fire
days.intention: Today's controlled reps teach your center to brace before your limbs move. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Long & Strong
days.intention: Pilates-style control today builds long, lean strength through your entire trunk. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Core & Cardio Charge
days.intention: Today your core learns to work while you move fast. That is real strength. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Perfect Practice
days.intention: Today's form-focused session protects your spine and multiplies your strength. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Sweat Equity

days.title: Recovery Ritual
days.intention: Recovery is where your body absorbs the week's work, so give it room today. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.
